correctness.rationale: The published component decomposition is recovered from the slope involution \(a\mapsto-a^{-1}\). Exact paired-domination polynomials of the resulting clique and biclique components multiply over the disjoint union. The minimum, counts, and polynomial reconstruction of \(q\) follow coefficientwise. Direct exhaustive checks over \(\mathbb F_3\), \(\mathbb F_4\), and \(\mathbb F_5\) agree exactly.
